annotations.text: Both QR slots are placeholders - drop in the real registration QR (front) and the GP DTS Facebook QR (back). The one on the original flyer was too small to re-use.
Photos are re-cropped from the two supplied flyer JPEGs, so they are low-resolution. Swap in the originals before printing.
All Khmer copy is lifted verbatim from the original flyers - nothing new was written. Still worth a native read before print.
